Yone

the Unforgotten
Mid laneTop lane

Top lane is where Yone is played most: about half of his games. He farms and trades on the 1v1 island, builds Blade of The Ruined King first to win duels against tanky top laners, then becomes a split-pushing, teamfighting carry. He's an A-tier top pick this patch.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

When to pick Yone

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Not a safe blind: lane bullies like Riven and Darius beat him early. Pick him when you know the enemy top.

Pick into

  • Scaling top laners he can out-trade, like Yorick
  • Tanks he shreds with mixed damage, like K'Sante
  • Teams that group tightly for fights
  • Games where you can split push

Avoid into

  • Early bullies like Riven and Darius
  • Duelists like Tryndamere
  • Teams with lots of crowd control
  • Teams with strong engage that locks him down

Great teammates

MalphiteHis ultimate groups enemies for Yone's R.
DianaHer pull sets up teamfights.
RellHer engage keeps enemies grouped.

Your team needs: Magic damage and engage from other roles.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Blade of The Ruined King first makes him strong in long 1v1 trades
  • Stacked Q and Soul Unbound give him escape tools against ganks
  • Great split pusher who can also join fights with Unleashed Teleport from the role quest
  • Fate Sealed starts teamfights by pulling several enemies together

Weaknesses

  • Early-game bullies like Riven and Darius out-trade him
  • Needs items before he can fight evenly
  • Point-and-click crowd control stops his engage
  • Easy to punish when he uses Soul Unbound badly

Power spikes

  • Level 2-3: you can trade with ranged top laners using Q stacks and W shield.
  • Level 6: Fate Sealed makes your all-ins much stronger.
  • First item (Blade of The Ruined King): you win long duels against tanks and bruisers.
  • Two items (Immortal Shieldbow): extra survivability when you get focused.
  • Three items (Infinity Edge): your crits make you a late-game carry.

Top tips

  • Stack Q on minions before you trade so your next Q knocks up.
  • Leave your body somewhere safe before using Soul Unbound.
  • Use Exhaust on the enemy's biggest damage dealer during all-ins.
  • Give up farm against lane bullies rather than fighting long trades early.
  • Split push once Blade of The Ruined King is done.
  • Use Unleashed Teleport from the role quest to join objective fights.
